location.climate: Four seasons, cold winters (-5°C to 2°C), warm summers (20-28°C)

english_proficiency.waiver_conditions: No formal English test requirement - proficiency shown through application

academic_programs.curriculum_structure: Gen Ed requirements + Concentration (major) + Electives + Distribution requirements

korean_student_specific.korean_food_access: H Mart in Cambridge (15 min), Korean restaurants in Allston (15 min), Korean bakeries in Harvard Square area
korean_student_specific.korean_church_proximity: Boston Hankook Church (20 min), Cambridge Korean Church (15 min)

historical_admit_patterns.common_profiles: Well-rounded students with national/international recognition, unique intellectual interests, strong leadership

korean_specific_advice: Harvard values 'T-shaped' students - deep expertise + broad interests
Show genuine intellectual curiosity and love of learning
Leadership with impact at scale is highly valued
The optional supplement essay is effectively required - treat it seriously
Interview is important - prepare to discuss intellectual interests in depth
Demonstrate how you'll contribute to residential House community
Show awareness of global issues, especially US-Korea relations if relevant
common_korean_applicant_mistakes: Profile too focused on STEM without showing humanities interests
Achievements impressive but lacking personal narrative or 'why'
Interview preparation too rehearsed - need genuine conversation
Not demonstrating potential for leadership at Harvard and beyond
Failing to show what questions drive them intellectually

campus_life.dining_options: House dining halls, Harvard Square restaurants, Annenberg (freshman dining)
campus_life.safety_rating: High - Harvard University Police, emergency services
campus_life.nearby_attractions: Boston, MIT, Charles River, Museums, Fenway Park, Historical sites

career_outcomes.korean_alumni_network: Very strong Harvard Korean Alumni Association with global chapters
